findings.friction_name: checkout dead-ends with a blank page after payment submit

severity_factors.frequency: 38% of users hit this on their first checkout

findings.narrative: The frequency factor is annotated as a cross-persona population/percentage estimate ('38% of users'), which F136 forbids — the isolated persona subagent scoring this friction cannot observe population-wide commonality; frequency must be scored as this persona's own re-encounter count within its own run (F12/F136 violation, CR2-11).
